name: NexusRPG
summary: NexusRPG is a persistent text-based browser MMORPG centered on one lasting character in a shared world spanning five connected Planes. A character's Main Hand and Off-hand equipment activate one of eight Classes, while players allocate Stat Points and progress through combat, Gathering, Crafting, trade, Quests, Pets, and equipment upgrades. Personal and Clan Dungeons preserve their generated maps, cleared rooms, opened Chests, position, stored rewards, and Boss Health between sessions. The world also supports shared World Boss encounters, Clans, PvP and Arenas, a player Market, and independent Kingdom territories that players can claim and contest.
